description: Stazioni radio-base is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver-ucvv.055055.it. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
